verdict.rationale: uv is a local, open-source Python package and project manager. It does not host user content or run AI services, so an opt-out from AI model training is a category error for this kind of product rather than a missing feature. Nothing in the evidence shows uv collecting user data or offering any AI-training-related control that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
